Plan, not record. September 2026 has not happened. This is what the planner would do, day by day, produced by the simulator that backtested August to within a fraction of a percent. Forecast demand is marked FORECAST; every declared assumption is flagged in the data. WhatsApp messages are simulated drafts — nothing was sent, nobody replied.

The changeover rule

an oil change costs TIME not material: 400 L of the next oil is run through and reused, plus 51.3 min clearance; a pack-size change on the same oil costs the 51.3 min clearance only. The flush oil comes back — the minutes don’t.

The PO-backed tag

When that run was scheduled, the SKU still had open pieces on a real customer order. Untagged runs build to the monthly plan’s FORECAST demand FORECAST — about 64% of September’s demand stream by litres is forecast, not orders.

This is a plan

Nothing below has been run. Only the 1-September opening is observed; every later day is computed, and the sequence re-plans as POs land — those days carry a “plan changed” note.

Printing: the day on screen prints alone; pick “All days” to print the month — one day per sheet.
